summary: WI DNR camping page, property page and campground map read; GoingToCamp refused (Azure WAF) so stored fees and policy-row booking stand. 127 wooded sites, 70 electric, showers/flush toilets/dump. --AWH coastal walk agrees with the DNR wording and imagery. PIN is 3.8 km off: it sits in woods by a creek south-west of the forest; the campground is between the lighthouse and the Nature Center at about 44.2150,-87.5105.
flags: PIN MOVE 3.8 km: stored 44.1827,-87.5273 is in unbroken forest beside a meandering creek about 1 km inland, with no campground. The DNR campground map puts the family campground between the Rawley Point lighthouse (imagery 44.2106,-87.5088) and the Nature Center Lodge to the north; on Esri imagery the loops run through the dune woods from about 44.2120 to 44.2180, west of the beach road. Target: 44.2150,-87.5105. (DNR 'Get directions' point 44.2113,-87.5102 is the forest office/entrance at the south end.)

WATERFRONT --AWH 'coastal walk' (report only): agrees. DNR: 'All of the sites are within walking distance of Lake Michigan... Because of the high sand dunes, none of the sites offer a view of the lake. All sites are wooded.' On imagery the eastern loop is about 100-150 m from the Lake Michigan beach through wooded dunes, with only park roads and the Lakeshore/Lighthouse picnic areas between; no highway, town or rail.
